name: agent-outcomes
description: Shared skill for writing the structured outcome artifact a loop appends to a comment it already posts, so the agent-orchestration Worker can read what happened and apply the labels itself. One marker format, one growing catalog of outcome shapes; loop plugins point here instead of each inventing their own. Bundles a PostToolUse hook (report-completion.sh) that signals the agent-orchestration Worker automatically, with no extra step for the loop: a completion when a loop posts the artifact, and heartbeats naming the step while it works (AGENT_OUTCOMES_ENDPOINT + AGENT_OUTCOMES_TOKEN; logs only without them). The GitHub write stays the only authoritative signal. Also bundles the work-log skill: how a loop records its decisions and what it verified in the Worker's decision log and build log, with log-entry.sh to add and read entries.
